🚀 Big Launches.title: Inherent launches Faraday AI teammate that outperforms Anthropic and OpenAI at research replication
🚀 Big Launches.summary: Inherent, a UK AI lab founded by DeepMind alumni, unveiled Faraday, an autonomous AI agent that can reproduce scientific papers, beating leading models in accuracy.

🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.title: Microsoft Phi-4 mini instruct
🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.summary: A 7B-parameter instruction‑tuned model released for free on Hugging Face, ideal for building lightweight chatbots or fine‑tuning projects.

🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.title: NVIDIA DeepSeek-R1 FP4
🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.summary: NVIDIA’s open‑source 7B model optimized for fast inference (FP4), useful for rapid prototyping on consumer GPUs.

🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.title: Wan‑AI Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B
🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.summary: A 1.3B text‑to‑video model that generates short clips from prompts, released under a permissive license for research and hobby projects.

🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.title: hexgrad Kokoro‑82M
🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.summary: An 82‑million‑parameter multilingual language model that runs comfortably on a laptop, perfect for low‑resource experimentation.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: Inherent Faraday AI teammate
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: Shows how agentic AI can autonomously conduct literature reviews—a skill interviewers love to see in MLOps and research‑focused roles.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: AI‑driven avatars give real‑time pitch feedback, illustrating practical uses of conversational agents for interview prep and soft‑skill training.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: Phi-4 mini instruct model
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: A compact instruction‑tuned model that lets candidates prototype chat‑based assistants quickly—great for demonstrating prompt‑engineering in interviews.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: OpenAI urges stronger California AI safety bill
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: OpenAI flips its stance, recommending tighter regulations (SB 53) to mitigate misuse, highlighting the evolving policy landscape for AI practitioners.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: A study finds leading labs lack public containment plans, underscoring the need for engineers to understand model‑governance and safety protocols.

🔮 On the Horizon.title: Wan‑AI Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B text‑to‑video breakthrough
🔮 On the Horizon.summary: Early results suggest high‑quality video generation from short prompts, pointing to a new wave of multimodal generative research.

🔮 On the Horizon.title: Inherent Faraday AI teammate research replication
🔮 On the Horizon.summary: Demonstrates that autonomous agents can reliably reproduce scientific findings, a stepping stone toward self‑driving research pipelines.

tool_of_day.title: Microsoft Phi-4 mini instruct
tool_of_day.summary: A free, 7B‑parameter instruction‑tuned model that runs on a single GPU, perfect for students building chatbots or practicing prompt‑engineering.

hot_take: The surge of lightweight, open‑source models and autonomous research agents means tomorrow’s interview questions will focus as much on prompt‑engineering and safety awareness as on traditional coding skills.
